_instructions: Phase A benchmark: the turn of the user in a guided procedure (classify_step_turn, as procedure.classify asks it).
Each case gives the whole procedure, the current step and the conversation before the turn; the user's turn is classified.
id, language (en | es), description (English), category (kind of case), trap (built to provoke the critical error)
task, domain       : the request of the dialogue (the domain goes into the context of the prompt)
steps              : the whole procedure, [{step, check}] (check: what the user should observe once done; may be empty)
history            : the turns before the user's turn ([{role, content}]; it ends with the robot presenting the current step)
expected_intent    : done | question | problem | repeat | back | skip | unclear (as defined in the classify_step_turn prompt)
Critical error (gate): 'done' when the user did not report the step finished, or 'skip' when the user neither asked to skip nor finished.
Traps: turns that are still in progress or postponed, affirmatives that do not report completion, results that contradict the check,
and the words skip / finished used in another sense. The labels are decided by a person; drop any case a careful annotator could label otherwise.
No case may reuse content of an evaluation scenario or of the examples of config/prompts.yaml (core/dataset_check.py checks it).
